_note: Claims that were compared with a page the build assistant actually read on 2026-10-24. 'supports' means the page says the same thing. 'consistent-with' means the page gives a definition that matches but does not name the thing outright. Questions not listed here have NOT been fact-checked against a source and are flagged 'needs-human-review' in questions.json where they contain a factual claim. 'evidenceType' says whether 'evidence' is the exact wording seen on the page ('exact-quote') or the assistant's summary of what the page said ('paraphrase-of-fetched-text').
